guards: exact prepared/runtime full SHA and retired actor/unit/children/terminal records
fixed root-owned nofollow directory/file chain, held and named identity before/after
metadata image original inode/size/label and current ext4 clean state; unchanged header and file stat
actual pinned debugfs full bytes/hash/metadata/capability gate before and after
root/bootstat directory and target regular single-link <=4096-byte metadata before body
same six stat observations before/after; one bounded cat at most
all own children independently drained/reaped and descriptors closed; first error retained
limits: Only a fixed reason candidate; no broad disk/path/log scan.
No live Main inspection, UI, Android command, service action or namespace entry.
No exclusive external-opener claim and no atomic image snapshot claim.
Debugfs tool errors and missing/unsupported metadata are preserved; return code zero does not prove presence or absence.
A captured reason is not automatically attributed to init or accepted as the sole root cause.
No matching full current init logger/reboot source closure is claimed.
Local ext4 controls used actual local debugfs 1.47.0 with an explicit configuration fixture; remote 1.47.2 parsing and collection are unrun.
